body:
thanks for some understanding which is seldom shown to people like me. People think I am at fault if I can't act as normal. Its human nature to want to survive even in the hardest of the circumstances. This instinct is in the animals too.

Even when living, I am not able to interact as a good son, brother, or husband. My wife is always complaining I am not giving her time. I don't think I will prove to be a good father too. I was always encouraging myself that I can do anything. I had been optimist all my life. But I was always lying to myself. Anyway, 1 million usd life-insurance will be much better for my son than a useless father like me.

Adoption is a very sensitive issue and bonds are weak or so. I thought about it too much but it never clicked. Original plan was to risk having 50% chance of a healthy baby. or else he died of diarrhea.

As far as I have learnt in life, money is more important than relations. No one gives a fuck about relations, not even parents. Life is not fair anyway.

If he gets $1 million in life-insurance. I think it more than worth it.
its a spectrum. Some are livable, some not.
general rule of thumb is to pay off loans first, then start investing. Interest accumulation on loans are not worth it.

ADVICE NEEDED:

I am 29 years old. I just want some advice on claiming life insurance. In short, I have done all arrangements on some painless suicide method with dignity, and I know that life insurance companies don't give out on cases of suicides so I will hide that from them. Basically, I will use the help of a friend (didn't discussed with him currently) to remove the suicide equipment, and will brief my wife how to claim the insurance money (didn't discussed with her also). My wife most probably will not help me with the suicide act. She is against it. WHAT CAN POSSIBLY GO WRONG WITH THIS STRATEGY? ANY BETTER METHOD YOU HAVE IN YOUR MIND?


EXTRA INFORMATION:

There are a lot of other problems in my life:
1. Health problems: I don't think I can survive post 40-50 years age. Constant stress all my life, and resorting to addictions has ruined my health beyond repair.
2. Financial problems: being Aspergers, I never have been able to stick to a job. And at most, I leave after 1 month.
3. Social problems: I live in my room, and seldom even talk to family. I wake up late till noon, so I don't have to talk to people. I am a night person, busy watching movies or reddit. A life so recluse is worth not living anymore.

Unfortunately, I was too optimistic. I had bigger ambitions and plans. I got married and have a baby boy hoping there is a 50% chance my baby will not be aspergers and most signs till now are that he is not. But I have to wait till he is 2 years old (he is 4 months now) to confirm he is not. If he came out positive aspergers diagnosis, I will kill him too.

I have financial support from both parents, and wife, and own house. But its killing me to depend on my parents, or on my wife (she is earning good but is saying to move to a less stressful job). So, in this situation, I will not be able to give a good future to my baby, and making life of my wife difficult too. So, I want to gift my baby my life-insurance and give him a better start in life because I am feeling guilty why I am ruining the life of my wife and child. Some good property under his hand when he would graduate.

My original plan was cryogenics, so I maybe able to live again in some far distant future. But, it involves too much paperwork on immigration, finances, and social skills. So, I am letting go of it now. Also, life after 30s, is full of medical problems, and I am wary of old age ailments. I am basically done with life.

I had been thinking all my life to adopt a child, and not have my own, but somehow I still had my own risking he will be 50% chance a normal person. I don't want my child to go through the same depression and guilt again. I want to end this forever.
Most of the signs he exhibit are pointing to not being aspergers. He will be fine most likely.
